description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402] Before paying or delivering to an agent or address: checks sanctions lists, on-chain activity on Base and Ethereum (wallet, contract or EIP-7702 wallet; transaction counts), whether it owns an ERC-8004 agent identity, its record of deals verified by the LogicNodes notary (settled, and deliveries that failed their re-run check) and payments it made to LogicNodes. Returns every component, a 0-100 indicator and the formula: start 50; sanctions match = 0 (do not transact); +10 if 10+ transactions on Base or Ethereum, +10 more if 100+; +15 if it owns an ERC-8004 agent identity; +3 per deal settled through the LogicNodes notary (max +20); +1 per payment it made to LogicNodes (max +5); +10 if a domain operator is verified; -25 per delivery that failed its re-run check; clamped to 0-100. A new address has little history, which is not evidence of bad behaviour.
